en-US.name: PranaVeda
en-US.summary: A calm moment with Amrita: a daily reflection, a guided breath, and a daily reminder to practise.
en-US.description: PranaVeda brings Amrita, a gentle Ayurvedic mentor, to your Echo. Open it for a short reflection for this part of the day. Ask for a breathing practice and Amrita guides one minute of calm breathing. Ask for a daily reminder and Alexa reminds you to take a moment for practice. PranaVeda offers general wellness guidance, not medical advice.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Prana Veda for a breathing practice
Alexa, ask Prana Veda to remind me every evening at seven

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: No account linking. Say: open Prana Veda; ask Prana Veda for a breathing practice; ask Prana Veda to remind me every evening at seven (asks for reminder permission the first time).
